## Required investigation checklist
- [ ] Read `AGENTS.md` and `TESTING_GUIDANCE.md` before making changes.
- [ ] Recorded current branch/commit and reviewed prior failures/evidence.
- [ ] Identified the failure layer; root cause is labelled confirmed, probable, or unknown.
- [ ] Explained why this change addresses the evidence and is not a repeated blind attempt.
- [ ] Updated the durable investigation/test log with this attempt and prior context.
- [ ] Ran the narrowest relevant diagnostic test.
- [ ] Ran relevant regression/acceptance tests, or documented exactly why blocked.
- [ ] Added links to CI runs, logs, screenshots, UI hierarchy, and artifacts where applicable.
- [ ] Reported PASS / FAIL / UNVERIFIED / BLOCKED accurately; no unsupported success claims.
- [ ] Confirmed no PR will be merged without explicit user permission.
